description:
The frame's Easton Taperwall Scandium tubes are so strong they can be
made thin for lightness. The bottom bracket shell and head tube are internally
thinned for lightness. The wall thickness and diameter of the main triangle
tubes and chainstays are size-specific. Larger frames get different tubes.
All the tube dimensions result from considered decisions made over years
and thousands of racing and training miles. No wonder great riders love
these frames.

No rule says you have to be as fast as Gord or Henk or Clark to ride a
Team Issue. There's nothing about a bike that's perfect for what they
do that makes it less perfect for what you do. Fuji Team Issue. It'll
never becommon, it'll never be ordinary and it'll never be anything but
the kick-butt best.
